fixes.answers: LOST: "Look around the room". "Orient yourself" is generic.

fixes.old: How does your body feel? Where are you grounded? Can you feel
fixes.answers: ADDED-CLAIM: "How does your body feel? Where are you grounded?" Two new orientation checks (P35).
fixes.why: checks Joel didn't give; taken out

fixes.answers: CHANGED: "The body may stay safe" is now "My body will be safe": a flat assurance, not a permission.

fixes.old: Say to yourself, "I'm not going anywhere."
fixes.new: Say to yourself, "I'm not going anywhere, and I'm coming more fully here."
fixes.answers: LOST: "I am coming more fully here".
fixes.why: spoken line had lost its second half

fixes.old: Tell yourself that as you move
fixes.answers: ADDED-CLAIM: "Tell yourself that as you move one of your hands, you're going to move deliberately, and as soon as you stop... you'll focus on what you've got." A new self-suggestion step before the script (P45).

fixes.old: You need to tell your analytical mind
fixes.new: You can tell your analytical mind
fixes.answers: CHANGED: "analysis can remain off duty" (a permission) becomes "You need to tell your analytical mind to stand down" (a required step).
fixes.why: required step back to a permission

fixes.old: stand down till the next day when you can take the time to do inner work and see any revelations.
fixes.new: stand down, any revelations can wait.
fixes.answers: ADDED-CLAIM: "till the next day when you can take the time to do inner work" sets the next day as the time for revelations; the published only says it can wait (P54).
fixes.why: no set time; revelation just waits

fixes.old: To be done: check out Nymja’s
fixes.answers: CHANGED: pointer to the sleep playlist. Name is spelled "Nymja"; framed as a draft note ("To be done: check out"), not a recommendation.
fixes.why: a pointer, under the published name

links.words: Instead of getting more relaxed with the hypnosis, try getting more alert

let_stand.item: CHANGED: "Contain before you deepen" is gone from the heading; only the body says stabilise so you can deepen. A "Variations" label is put in front.
CHANGED: trigger list. "Intense beauty" is now "seeing something you love"; "music" is "beautiful music". List ends "etc" (see ADDED).
let_stand.why: examples only; the 'already open' condition is kept

let_stand.item: CHANGED: "I do not need to intensify it" is gone; only implied by "you just need to".
let_stand.why: "just need to" still says only aim and stabilise

let_stand.item: CHANGED: the thumb press is now one example ("eg") of "make some contact with yourself"; any self-contact seems allowed.
let_stand.why: the press is the only example given; friction focus kept

let_stand.item: CHANGED: "only in the amount I can live well with" becomes "that I can integrate". The limit on amount is now a limit on kind.
let_stand.why: a limit stays; P36's line already limits amount

let_stand.item: CHANGED: heading drops "when your mind likes to escape"; that condition now sits only on the hand-movement paragraph.
let_stand.why: condition stays in the body (daydreaming, "mentally escape")

let_stand.item: CHANGED: "bring me gently into the present" is "bring me back to now"; "gently" is dropped. "Show me what I am avoiding" is kept.
CHANGED: "small repeated hand movement with increasing clarity" becomes "move deliberately"; the clarity pairing survives only in the script.
let_stand.why: the script right after keeps the pairing

let_stand.item: CHANGED: "Again — clearer, not sleepier": "clearer" stays, "not sleepier" is dropped.
let_stand.why: "clearer" keeps the direction; restoring adds a ", not Y" tail
heading and "to go to sleep" carry it; restoring adds a tidy closing line

let_stand.item: ADDED: "Variations" label before the first section.
let_stand.why: a label; nothing to act on

let_stand.item: ADDED-CLAIM: "for some reason (... etc)" makes the trigger list open-ended, so the section applies to any cause (P33).
let_stand.why: the heading "Already open?" already covers any opened state; the list reads as examples

let_stand.item: ADDED: "Say something like" before the scripts (P36, P38, P44, P45) makes the wording optional, including the safety lines in P36.
ADDED: "To be done:" draft note and "to go to sleep listening to hypnosis" in the playlist line (P55).
let_stand.why: "To be done:" goes in the P55 fix; the rest only says what the playlist is for
